svg.title: Canonical parabolic descent and a type-changing curve reduction
svg.desc: CF.1–CF.12 identify the full scheme stabilizer with a cocharacter parabolic and descend its projective flag quotient. CF.13–CF.20 give an exact SL4 degeneration whose extended two-plane differs from the canonical special flag.
svg.text: A canonical group stabilizer; a noncanonical special reduction
Characteristic zero · any field for descent · every genus for curve extension
1. The whole scheme stabilizer (CF.1–CF.9)
D(A) = { g ∈ G(A) : Ad(g)Fʲ = Fʲ for all j }, including nonreduced A
Over an algebraic closure: P = P_G(λ) ⊂ D and Lie(D) = F⁰ = Lie(P)
Local dimension = tangent dimension ⇒ D smooth; D⁰ = P
D ⊂ N_G(P) = P ⇒ D = P. The fixed-flag equations descend to Qₑ/K.
G/Qₑ ↪ Fl(g) is closed and projective; G → G/Qₑ is a Qₑ-torsor.
2. Extend the generic reduction on the entire curve (CF.10–CF.12)
P/Q ↪ Fl(ad P) → X : projective flag bundle; generic section extends at each DVR
Primitive Plücker coordinates extend; closed equations persist in the domain.
The Higgs projection to (ad P / n_Q) ⊗ ω vanishes generically, hence everywhere.
3. Exact split block model (CF.13–CF.14)
e = E₁₃ + E₂₄; h = diag(1,1,−1,−1)
adjoint weight
multiplicity
dim F⁰ = 11; dim F¹ = 4; G/Q = Gr(2,4)
4. Real inner form (CF.15)
A = M₂(ℍ); G = SL₁(A); real split rank 1
λ(t) = diag(t,t⁻¹) on the right module ℍ²
Q preserves ℍ ⊕ 0; adjoint dimensions 4,7,4
After ℂ-extension: the same Gr(2,4) type.
5. Exact DVR degeneration: R = k[[s]], K = k((s)) (CF.16–CF.20)
N = s⁴ g e g⁻¹, g = [ I 0 ; diag(s⁻¹,s⁻²) I ]; N² = 0
W_R = ⟨w₁ = s e₁ + e₃, w₂ = s² e₂ + e₄⟩; a rank-two direct summand
Nw₁ = Nw₂ = 0; columns of N: −s²w₁, −w₂, s³w₁, s²w₂
Generic fibre: rank N = 2
canonical type (2,2)
Special fibre: N₀ = −E₄₂, rank 1
extended W₀ = ⟨e₃,e₄⟩ has type (2,2)
Canonical special flag: ⟨e₄⟩ ⊂ ⟨e₁,e₃,e₄⟩; type (1,2,1)
The extended reduction still contains N in its nilradical. Properness keeps the generic flag type.
Proof: §§6.2.3–6.2.4. Group comparison: Conrad, Reductive group schemes, Cor.5.2.8–5.2.9 (free author PDF).
